map.卡路里消耗估算（静息代谢率） 使用指南: Calorie expenditure estimation (resting metabolic rate) user guide
map.对比三种主流公式计算静息代谢率（RMR），结合活动水平给出减脂/维持/增肌的每日: Compare three mainstream formulas for resting metabolic rate (RMR), and give daily calorie target ranges for fat-loss/maintenance/muscle-gain by activity level.
map.同时用 Mifflin-St Jeor 与 Harris-Benedict 两公: Use both Mifflin-St Jeor and Harris-Benedict to estimate resting metabolic rate, observe inter-method differences and take the mean.
map.已知体脂率时追加 Katch-McArdle 公式（基于去脂体重），提高对健身人: When body fat rate is known, add the Katch-McArdle formula (based on lean body mass) to improve estimation accuracy for fitness people.
map.以估算值作为热量摄入基线，配合活动系数制定减脂或增肌目标。: Use the estimated value as the calorie intake baseline, with an activity factor to set fat-loss or muscle-gain goals.
map.：Mifflin-St Jeor：男 10×体重 + 6.25×身高 − 5×年: : Mifflin-St Jeor: male 10 x weight + 6.25 x height - 5 x age + 5; female -161. Harris-Benedict (revised): male 88.362 + 13.397 x weight + 4.799 x height - 5.677 x age; female 447.593 + 9.247 x weight + 3.098 x height - 4.330 x age. Katch-McArdle (needs body-fat rate): lean body mass LBM = weight x (1 - body-fat%), BMR = 370 + 21.6 x LBM. With body-fat blank, average the first two; when filled, average all three.
map.：男性 65 kg / 170 cm / 30 岁、未填体脂率：Mifflin: : male 65 kg / 170 cm / 30 yr, body fat blank: Mifflin = 1567.5 approx 1568 kcal, Harris-Benedict = 88.362 + 870.805 + 815.83 - 170.31 approx 1605 kcal, mean approx 1586.1 kcal, the two differ by about 37 kcal (2.4%). Adding body fat 20%: LBM = 65 x 0.8 = 52 kg, Katch-McArdle = 370 + 21.6 x 52 = 1493 kcal, three-form mean approx 1555.1 kcal. Compare female 55 kg / 160 cm / 28 yr, body fat 28%: Mifflin approx 1249, Harris-Benedict approx 1331, Katch-McArdle (LBM 39.6 kg) approx 1225, three-form mean approx 1268.3 kcal.
map.有体脂率时为什么 Katch-McArdle 更可信？: Why is Katch-McArdle more credible when body fat rate is known?
map.静息代谢主要来自去脂体重（肌肉、内脏、脑），脂肪组织代谢活性很低。Katch-M: Resting metabolism mainly comes from lean body mass (muscle, organs, brain); fat tissue has very low metabolic activity. Katch-McArdle models directly with lean body mass, so high-body-fat people are overestimated by weight formulas and low-body-fat (high-muscle) people underestimated. The premise is reliable body-fat data - bioelectrical impedance scales often have +/-3-5 percentage-point error, which amplifies onto BMR; if the body-fat source is unreliable, just use Mifflin-St Jeor.
map.三个公式结果相差几十千卡有意义吗？: Does a difference of tens of kcal among the three formulas matter?
map.对制定饮食计划而言，几十千卡的差异（约 2%-3%）小于食物称重、活动系数估计与: For diet planning, a difference of tens of kcal (about 2%-3%) is smaller than the errors from food weighing, activity-factor estimation and daily fluctuation (often over 10%); no need to obsess over which. The truly meaningful use is fixing one formula to track trends long-term, and back-correcting your real expenditure from 2-4 weeks of actual weight change.
